# Phase 5 Plans Checklist: QuickFlow Personal Productivity Workspace

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality check for the Phase 5 (User Story 4 - Build and run time-boxed plans) acceptance criteria AS1-AS10 and FR-017..FR-025 used by loop-3 testing: plan fields and validation, item selection, derived status / progress / rest time, start notification, item side effects, grouping/history, removal and UX states.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (testing loop), focus US4 acceptance criteria + validation/API errors + status derivation/side effects + notification/UX states.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is it specified whether the plan title is trimmed before the 1-200 length rule is applied? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the relationship between estimated duration and the start/end window specified (may duration exceed end − start)? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified which items are pickable (archived tasks, inactive habits, completed cards) and what the server does when an unpickable source is submitted? [Completeness, Spec §US4 AS1]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the handling of the same source selected twice in one plan specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK005 Is it specified whether a plan can be edited after creation (title, times, items)? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the order of items inside a plan specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the rounding rule for progress percentage (e.g. 1/3 → 33, 2/3 → 67) specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the boundary behaviour at exactly now = start and now = end defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "rest time" format and its value at the end boundary (0 vs hidden) defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "highlight the plan" defined with observable, measurable properties (duration, visual)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "notified once" defined across devices/tabs and across reloads (server-side acknowledgement)? [Clarity, Spec §US4 AS6]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "final completion percentage" in history defined as the percentage at end time or the current percentage? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 Is the Completed-by-all-done rule consistent with undoing an item later (plan returns to In Progress)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the "removed source" rule consistent with progress counting (removed items still count)? [Consistency, Spec §US4 AS9, §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the task side effect (set Done) and the task completedAt rules from US1 consistent when the task is already Done? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the ordering of active plans (priority, then start) consistent between the Plans page and the dashboard? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, §FR-026]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Can "updates immediately" for progress on plan and dashboard be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §US4 AS3]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the rest-time update frequency stated with a verifiable target (once per minute minimum / once per second target)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK019 Are the validation messages for no items, empty title and end ≤ start specified by field? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US4 AS2]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for a plan whose end has passed with open items at creation time? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for the start notification when the app was closed at start time and the plan already ended? [Coverage, Spec §US4 AS6]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for the empty state and the "no active plans, only history" state? [Coverage, Spec §US4 AS10]
- [ ] CHK023 Are remove-confirmation and cancel paths specified? [Coverage, Spec §US4 AS8]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK024 Is behaviour specified when a habit item is marked done but the habit already has today's completion? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK025 Is behaviour specified when the source of an item is deleted before the item is marked done (no side effect)? [Edge Case, Spec §US4 AS9]
- [ ] CHK026 Is behaviour specified for client/server clock skew in derived status and rest time? [Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK027 Are long-title truncation requirements for plan cards specified? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Are accessibility requirements specified for the live countdown (screen reader verbosity) and builder tabs? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK029 Are browser-notification permission requirements (denied / default) specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-023]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK030 Is the dependency on Settings notification preferences (Phase 6) for plan-start notifications documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-023, §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the assumption that "today" for habit side effects uses the server local date documented? [Assumption, Spec §FR-024]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
